ruleset.name: Kiln
ruleset.description: Kiln's code-smell rules (BUILD-10). Checkstyle limits size and nesting (BUILD-9); these catch code that's hard to follow, and smells Error Prone doesn't cover. PreserveStackTrace is left out on purpose: refusals drop causes so a client never sees a stack trace or its own input.

rule.name: KilnValidateWithMatches
rule.message: Validate with matches(), which anchors the pattern; find() accepts any input containing a match
rule.description: Input validation must match the whole value.

rule.name: KilnNoUrlDecoder
rule.message: Don't percent-decode with URLDecoder: decode only the escapes the protocol allows, exactly once
rule.description: URLDecoder decodes every escape and treats '+' as a space.

rule.name: KilnNoShell
rule.message: Run commands as an argument list with ProcessBuilder, never through Runtime.exec or a shell
rule.description: A shell would interpret metacharacters in arguments.

rule.name: KilnNoHandBuiltJson
rule.message: Write JSON with a JSON writer such as FormatJson, never by joining strings
rule.description: Concatenated JSON lets a value break out of its string.

rule.name: KilnCompilePatternsOnce
rule.message: Compile a Pattern once, in a static final field
rule.description: Compiling a regex is expensive; doing it per call is avoidable work.

rule.name: KilnNoListSearchInLoop
rule.message: Searching a List inside a loop is O(n^2); use a Set or Map lookup
rule.description: contains, indexOf and remove(Object) scan the whole list.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: KilnNoRegexInLoop
rule.message: This compiles a regex on every iteration; use a static final Pattern
rule.description: String.matches, replaceAll, replaceFirst and split compile their regex each call.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName=('matches','replaceAll','replaceFirst','split')][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String')]] [ancestor::Block[parent::ForStatement or parent::ForeachStatement or parent::WhileStatement or parent::DoStatement]]
